study.title: Selected Western Ghats forest landscape
study.question: Are vegetation signals spatially consistent across a matched-season pair in a rugged forest block, and how much is explained by terrain shadow?
limitations: Topographic shadow and canopy structure complicate index interpretation.

aoi.boundary_source: Manually placed over a forested block; site to be confirmed.

can_conclude: Masked NDVI differences between matched dry-season observations (3-day day-of-year gap) on one grid.
Whether candidate change areas are spatially associated with terrain: the bundle embeds Copernicus DEM elevation context for the same window.
Threshold sensitivity of the candidate-change area.
cannot_conclude: Deforestation: an NDVI decrease is a candidate spectral signal only.
Separation of plantation from natural forest, or of dry-season leaf-drop from disturbance.

attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2020-2026), processed by ESA; L2A products distributed by the Element 84 Earth Search STAC catalogue (AWS Open Data). DEM: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (ESA/DLR) where included. Event context: NDRRMA (2025) and ICIMOD (2026) situation reporting, cited as external literature, not project measurements.

catalog.license: Copernicus Sentinel data: free, open and unrestricted use with attribution (ESA Copernicus data policy). Catalogue: Element 84 Earth Search, AWS Open Data.

ndvi.label: NDVI

ndvi.label: observed index difference (later - earlier); not a land-cover verdict
ndvi.area_convention: planimetric pixel area on the projected analysis grid; hectares and square kilometres converted from square metres
ndvi.interpretation_guardrail: observed index difference at the stated threshold; not a land-cover classification, deforestation/wetland-loss verdict, building count or causal attribution

ndwi.label: observed index difference (later - earlier); not a land-cover verdict
ndwi.area_convention: planimetric pixel area on the projected analysis grid; hectares and square kilometres converted from square metres
ndwi.interpretation_guardrail: observed index difference at the stated threshold; not a land-cover classification, deforestation/wetland-loss verdict, building count or causal attribution

area_cross_check.method: projected polygon area, independent geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid, and rasterised pixel-count area on the analysis grid
area_cross_check.note: the raster area differs from the polygon area by boundary rasterisation only; hectares and km2 are converted from projected square metres, not from degrees

limitations: Topographic shadow and canopy structure complicate index interpretation.
Composites are robust within-period summaries of a few observations, not a dense time series; inter-annual change is represented by two period composites only.
Index differences are candidate spectral signals. They are not verified deforestation, wetland loss, construction, glacier damage or any other causal land-cover label.
Cloud, shadow and saturated-pixel exclusion relies on the provider SCL product; terrain shadow is not independently re-derived.
Surface reflectance is the provider L2A product; no independent atmospheric correction is performed.
Areas are planimetric on the documented projected grid; UTM scale distortion at this AOI is small but nonzero.
summary.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data, processed by ESA; L2A products distributed by the Element 84 Earth Search STAC catalogue (AWS Open Data).

method.source: frozen M1 difference rasters + common-valid masks
method.threshold_rule: recorded primary threshold of each index (|Δ| ≥ t)
method.geometry: rasterio.features.shapes on the native UTM grid, projected to WGS84 (pyproj); no hand-drawn geometry
method.area_convention: pixel count × pixel area on the projected analysis grid

interpretation.title: ▼ Candidate NDVI decrease · Region 01
interpretation.observed_measurement: Mean ΔNDVI -0.366 index units (median -0.381 index units) at the recorded threshold |Δ| ≥ 0.15; 47 px = 0.47 ha = 0.02 % of the 237,774-px shared-valid footprint.
interpretation.meaning: A NDVI decrease here marks where the later forest composite reads lower in NDVI. In this terrain the validity footprint is complete, but terrain shadow and illumination geometry can still colour the spectral comparison.
explanations: Terrain shadow and illumination differences between acquisitions.
Canopy density or phenology differences between the windows.
Canopy disturbance — candidate only; independent evidence would be required to establish it.
interpretation.evidence_strength: Shared-valid coverage for this comparison is 100.00 % of the AOI (237,774 px). The region is a connected 47-px component at a stated threshold — adjacent pixels are not independent observations, so no significance is claimed. Candidate spectral signal with stated thresholds, not independently verified change.
cannot_conclude: That deforestation occurred (no independent verification).
A distinction between shadow effects and real canopy change.
